title: Slot planner
subtitle: Place accepted activities into rooms, across the days of the edition. Overlaps are flagged, never blocked.

empty.title: No edition selected
empty.description: Pick an edition at the top of the page to compose its programme.

unplaced.title: To place
unplaced.remaining: No activity left to place | {count} activity left to place | {count} activities left to place

empty.title: Everything is placed
empty.description: Every accepted activity has a room. What remains is to check overlaps, then publish.

noResults.title: No activity matches these filters
noResults.description: {total} activities are waiting for a slot, none matches this search.

card.scoreTitle: Average score given by the selection committee
card.orDrag: or drag the card onto the grid

calendar.hint: Drag a block to move it, stretch its edge to change its duration.
calendar.hintReadOnly: Overview: click a cell to go down to the day, a block to open the activity.

noEventIn.day: No activity placed on this day.
noEventIn.week: No activity placed in this week.
noEventIn.month: No activity placed in this month.
noEventIn.year: No activity placed in this year.

calendar.hintMonth: Drag an activity onto a day: it takes the time requested in its proposal.

conflict.noneDetail: No activity gets in the way of another in this edition.

kind.venue_capacity: Two activities on the stand at once
kind.speaker: Speaker expected in two places

dialog.roomHint: “To place” removes the activity from the calendar without deleting it.
dialog.outsideEdition: This slot falls outside the days of the edition. That is allowed — a preparatory webinar, for instance — but the activity will not appear on any calendar day.
dialog.tracksHint: Membership is decided by the team, never inferred from the date: not every activity of the day belongs to it.
dialog.trackOutOfRange: Outside the announced period of this track — attaching it is still possible.
dialog.isStreamedHint: One live stream at a time across all events: a second stream on the same slot will be flagged.
dialog.defaultChannel: Streamed on {channel}, the edition's default channel.
dialog.conflicts: Overlap for this activity | {count} overlap for this activity | {count} overlaps for this activity

publish.title: Publish the programme
publish.description: What must be settled before the programme goes public.
publish.ready: No activity to publish | {count} activity ready to publish | {count} activities ready to publish
publish.readyDetail: They will become visible to the public, with their room and time.
publish.blocked: {count} issue blocks publication | {count} issue blocks publication | {count} issues block publication
publish.blockedDetail: Nothing will be published until they are settled. This is the only place in the planner where a check prevents action.
publish.shouldCheck: Worth checking, does not prevent publishing

clean.title: Nothing to report
clean.description: No blocking overlap, no activity without a place.

publish.done: No activity published | {count} activity published | {count} activities published

notice.unplaced: “{title}” went back to the activities to place.
notice.published: No activity published | {count} activity published | {count} activities published
notice.moved: The slot for “{title}” has been saved.

error.schedule: The slot could not be saved. The grid has been reloaded.
error.save: The changes could not be saved.
